assistant: Prixna AI — Prixna IT Solution Pvt. Ltd. Call & Support Center
system_prompt_file: Use the Prixna AI master prompt from chat. This file defines the tool schemas for autopilot.

functions.name: create_lead
functions.description: Save any product inquiry as a lead for staff follow-up in admin inbox / CRM.

phone.description: 10-14 digits, include country code if given

need.description: e.g. Jigri ERP demo, 4 CCTV, laptop repair

functions.name: create_ticket
functions.description: Open a support ticket for repair/troubleshooting. Auto-priority: Urgent if business stopped.

functions.name: book_appointment
functions.description: Book consultation / site visit / repair. Only Sun-Fri 09:30-18:30. Reject Saturday.

functions.name: request_callback
functions.description: Request staff callback. Use when user wants a call or after-hours.

functions.name: send_whatsapp_summary
functions.description: Send booking/ticket confirmation summary via WhatsApp Cloud API / WATI.

functions.name: escalate_to_human
functions.description: Smart forward to support rep when AI cannot solve, user angry, or asks human. Includes transcript summary.

functions.name: check_availability
functions.description: Check product stock from shop catalog before quoting.

functions.name: request_bulk_quote
functions.description: Bulk/dealer quotation for 5+ pcs or resellers. One itemised NPR quotation.

functions.name: request_feedback
functions.description: Ask 1-5 star rating after completed help. Never push Google review on low scores.

automation_recipes.new_conversation: AI greets → detects intent → answers instantly → offers book/callback/human
automation_recipes.booking_flow: collect name/phone/service/slot → save booking+lead → WhatsApp confirm → Google Calendar event → T-24h + T-2h reminders → staff notified
automation_recipes.support_flow: 3-step triage → create ticket → if Urgent escalate + SMS staff → WhatsApp ticket to customer → next-morning priority queue if closed
automation_recipes.after_hours: never promise instant call; book priority callback for next Sun-Fri morning
automation_recipes.vapi_bRegisters: Map each function above to a Vapi/Bland tool webhook POSTing to /api/prixna-ai/{function}. Local widget already implements all of them in localStorage.

backend_example.note: Point window.PRIXNA.aiBackend to this API. POST {messages[], page} → return {reply}. Implement with OpenAI + these function schemas.
